debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 194.7), absent intermediate/long-term trend alignment (EMA 20/50 and SMA 50/200 bearish), weak ADX (16.35), Ichimoku cloud resistance, high earnings risk in 40 days, and zero fundamental/smart money conviction overwhelm short-term technicals.
